title.zh_CN: Vinput 2.3.5 — 空闲后录音启动更快

text.en_US: Cold push-to-talk no longer rebuilds the PipeWire capture stream every time. The mic path reuses an inactive stream with a short idle grace, opens capture before ASR session setup, and softens offline VAD leading trim — reducing dropped leading words after idle.
text.zh_CN: 空闲后第一次按键不再每次重建 PipeWire 采集流。录音路径会在短空闲宽限内复用 inactive stream，并先开麦再创建 ASR session，同时放宽 offline VAD 前缘裁切，减少「开头字被吃掉」的问题。
